label: phosphorothioate defense system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a DNA phosphorothioation-dependent restriction locus that pairs host DNA phosphorothioate modification with Dnd- or Ssp-family restriction activity to nick unmodified invading DNA and inhibit bacteriophage replication.
observations: DNA-phosphorothioation branch under phage defense system; distinct from DNA PT as a chemical modification, DndABCDE, DndFGH, SspABCD, SspE, SspFGH, and individual dnd or ssp genes and proteins; individual Dnd and Ssp subfamilies; individual source rows naming one PT locus; restriction-modification in general; and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, CRISPR-Cas, and abortive infection.
